lines.text: *Scribble, scribble*
Arcana has started her library committee work in earnest.
However, she won't tell me any specifics about what she's doing, despite my asking.
She says she doesn't want to tell me because I'd probably try to help if she did.
*Scribble, scribble*
As for me, I'm also in the library, taking care of a little overtime work after Arcana persuaded me to do it here instead of in the teachers' office.
*Scribble, scribble*
Speaking of whom...
I look over at Arcana,
who's sitting by the window, taking in the spring breeze while she works.
She seems to be skimming through several books and organizing some things.
Given how bubbly and energetic she usually is, I never imagined she could be this...
... Calm.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hm?
Arcana lifts her head and looks at me.
Sorry. It just sorta slipped out.
It's just...
I normally don't ever see you be this... calm.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... What?
It's just a thought that I had.
You've been a little different since starting here at school,
and seeing you now, it kinda reminded me that...
Suddenly, Arcana puts down her pen.
Hm?
She gets up and walks over to my desk.
... She looks serious.
What is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Time-out.
Time-out?
Arcana moves as if to hug me...
then starts to lightly punch me repeatedly in the chest.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: How many times have I told you since we first met?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm a cold, ruthless professional!
Y-yeah, but...
... wasn't that a joke?
The punches start getting stronger.
No, I'm being serious!
Who would ever look at you and think you're cold and ruthless?
Arcana stops hitting me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A lot of people, actually.
... Huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I used to get that a lot,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: back when I had just become a Nikke.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Granted, I was kinda like that even before I was a Nikke.
You remember that?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I mean, the whole reason I took over at the Forbidden Library in the first place was out of a sense of duty.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It'd be weird to feel that way while not remembering my time as a human, no?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess they could've messed with my memories and forced me into this job,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: but our boss isn't that kind of person.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, after work, whenever I went out or met someone,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: a lot of people would say that sort of thing,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: that I seemed cold and detached.
I can't imagine it...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Really? Then I'll show you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Give me a second...
Arcana takes a deep breath, clasps her hands, and focuses.
Her eyes go cold and emotionless. She starts to turn her gaze toward me, and then...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Pfft. I can't do it.
Why're you laughing?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can't help it. Looking at you makes me happy.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, you admit it now, right?
That you're cold and ruthless?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah.
... Okay, I'll admit it.
I admit nothing.
Arcana makes an ominous expression,
and reaches toward a small potted plant by the window...
Okay, I admit it! I admit it!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Good boy.
Arcana gently strokes my hair.
... Is it really that important, though?
None of it changes the fact that you're you.
What?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You shouldn't always say such nice things.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
Arcana looks at the flower blooming in the pot by the window.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Honestly...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I guess it doesn't matter that much at this point.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Still, I need to remember what I was like before I became this happy,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: so I don't take it for granted.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I have to keep reminding myself of it,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: or else I'm liable to get caught up in the here and now,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and forget who I am and what I need to do.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's the same now.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you hadn't steadied me like you did,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I just might've turned into a spoiled child.
... I can't imagine that, either.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Really?
Arcana leans into me.
She rubs her cheek against my chest.
Wh-what are you doing?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Is it so hard to imagine now?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If, from the time you started at your job up until now,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: you spent almost all of your time alone,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: wouldn't it only be natural to crave the warmth and affection of another?
Arcana looks up at me with slightly teary eyes.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Honestly, I'm pretty sad about this whole setup.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I pretended to be okay with it all back in the storage room,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: when in reality it makes me really sad. It feels like a giant missed opportunity.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But you know...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: seeing you work so hard at being a teacher, even though it's not your actual job,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: it made me decide to put my feelings on hold and work hard too, even though I'm not really a student.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's just... Eh?!
I pull Arcana into a hug.
It's hard to explain,
but it felt as if she'd disappear any moment if I didn't.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: L-let go... please.
No.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... If you keep doing this,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I really might stop holding back and do whatever I want.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'll work on enticing you every day,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: texting you during class,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: showing up at your room,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and doing much more than that, just to make up for how much I've been holding back.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So please,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: let me keep being a model student, and also...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: the manager of the Forbidden Library. Okay?
Stroke Arcana's hair.
Pull Arcana into an even tighter hug.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uh...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Pfft. What're you doing?
... Giving you a compliment.
You've been working so hard at both school and the Forbidden Library,
and you've done a great job.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If I keep it up, will you give me more compliments?
Of course.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It feels nice being complimented, especially as you run your fingers through my hair.
Have you never been complimented like this before?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Who exactly do you think would do something like this for me?
... Fair point.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe.
Arcana pulls away.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thanks. I'm feeling recharged!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've got enough energy to last about four and a half hours now!
It's not a very long-lasting charge, is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But it was fast, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's why you need to compliment me more often! Just tell me how well I'm doing
And that's enough for you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup.
Arcana picks up a small watering can and waters the potted plant by the window.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What else would I need?
As our brief "break" comes to an end,
we return to our seats and finish our work,
and then leave the library, making sure to turn off the lights and lock up on our way out.
Arcana.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah?
... I know it's a little weird to ask this now,
but do you have any regrets?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: About what?
About your time here at school,
and how it's passing by so uneventfully.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No, I'm okay.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: After all, I'm with you, Mr. {AccountData.NickName}.
We can't always be together, though.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah... That part's a little disappointing.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Actually, now that I think about it, it's really disappointing!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Not only do we not get to see each other often,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: but we're teacher and student, so we can't even do anything all that intense! Agh!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's lacking in both quantity and quality...!
Arcana clutches her head and slumps down.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why're you smiling? I'm being serious.
Nothing, it's just...
This feels like such a "you" way to react.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What's that supposed to mean...?
Arcana sighs and lets her shoulders droop.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, now that this serious problem has been brought to my attention, here's an assignment for both of us.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: While properly adhering to the roles of teacher and student,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: we need to figure out a way to create some romantic moments!
I thought about it for a second, but can't think of anything.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Me neither! We're doomed!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: *Sigh...* I guess that leaves us with only one option.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: At this point, we just have to focus on maintaining the status quo,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and then aim for a last-minute comeback.
You wanna bet it all on the fourth quarter, huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: As they say, you only live once!
We continue chatting until we arrive at the intersection leading to our respective rooms.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well, good job today... Actually, speaking of work.
What is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mr. {AccountData.NickName},

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: do you realize that, ever since starting work at this school,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: you've worked late every single day, without exception?
R-really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yes, really.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I know how you are and everything, but that's not good for you.
Hmm... Okay. I'll take it easy.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Liar. You were gonna keep working, weren't you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Look, just don't overdo it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: For tonight at least, go straight to your room and get some rest.
Arcana holds out her pinky finger.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Promise me.
... Okay. Promise.
It's okay. Do whatever you want.
I can handle it. There's only one of you, after all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But what about the other students?
Privaty can take care of them.
I'm just an assistant, remember?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: What about the Forbidden Library?
It's a problem for another day.
I'll manage it somehow.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Sounds irresponsible to me.
I'll be responsible for you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Now you sound like a player.
Do you dislike it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: No.
Arcana takes my hand and brings it to her cheek.
I feel a warm, pleasant heat.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: My heart's racing.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Can we go to your room right now?
My room?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm not planning on doing anything. I just...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I wanna lean against you and put my head on your shoulder,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and then fall asleep without having to worry about what others think,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: all the while feeling your warmth.
... But we both still have work left to do.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We can finish it tomorrow.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Or the day after.
... You really are becoming spoiled.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I told you, hehe.
I stand up and take Arcana's hand.
Let's go. Are you hungry?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I am.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Actually, now that I think about it,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: isn't this going to be the first time we eat together since coming here?
Is it?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: So, to commemorate the occasion, I'll make us something.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Is there anything in particular you want to eat?
The question you should be asking is whether there's anything we can actually make.
I have nothing in my fridge.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Really?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then let's go grocery shopping.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: From now on, I'll make you dinner every day.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Would you like a packed lunch as well?
You'd do that for me?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course! I can do it from now until forever.
Arcana and I leave the school together.
While I may be wearing a suit and she may be wearing a school uniform,
if someone were to hear us talking, they'd never think we were a teacher and a student.
